verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe exposing a port and getting a public preview URL to reach services running in the sandbox (ports API, cloudflare-sandbox-docs-31, cloudflare-sandbox-docs-46, cloudflare-sandbox-docs-5). They also document routing of incoming HTTP and WebSocket requests to the right sandbox container (cloudflare-sandbox-docs-15). Zero-config trycloudflare.com tunnels via sandbox.tunnels.get(port) are an additional option (cloudflare-sandbox-docs-6, cloudflare-sandbox-docs-36). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that preview URLs work as described.
